directAnswer.en: This is a grid-powered building pour through a pipeline. This page prints a fine-stone cell of 80 m horizontal / 240 m vertical. It does not print an aggregate-13 row. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Electric Low Pressure 40 at 37 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, fine stone 80 m / 240 m, hopper 0.3 m³, Kawasaki 112, 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm and 1200 kg. Do not move the same condition onto Electric 30, which prints 30 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, fine stone 60 m / 180 m, aggregate-13 20 m / 60 m, maximum aggregate ≤ 3 cm, hopper 0.3 m³, 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm and 1200 kg. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.

body.en: Send the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical line you measured, and the supply the printed motor needs. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job, a price or a daily volume.
body.zh: 请发送配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及已印电机需要的电源。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上项目名称、国家工程、价格或日方量。

question.en: Is the photograph a Pinjin jobsite?

answer.en: No. It shows this kind of work. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not name it as a contract record.

question.en: What does the Electric Low Pressure 40 row print for this check?

answer.en: This page prints a fine-stone cell of 80 m horizontal / 240 m vertical. It does not print an aggregate-13 row.

question.en: Is the printed output a contract volume?
question.zh: 印出的输送量是合同方量吗？

answer.en: No. Electric Low Pressure 40 prints theoretical catalogue figures only. This page names no floor, no contract volume and no price.
answer.zh: 不是。电动低压40只印理论目录数字。本页不写楼层、合同方量或价格。
